patch_description:
This version combines conflict-directed repair with a new pair-budget guided refill strategy.  It treats a C4-free graph as a resource allocation problem: every new edge consumes potential cross-neighborhood pairs, so saturation prioritizes low-degree endpoint pairs while avoiding excessive degree concentration.

The algorithm remains genuinely input-dependent. It begins from several differently repaired versions of the supplied adjacency matrix and from several source-edge retention orders. Each valid candidate is saturated using safe bitset additions. A small archive is then improved through tabu ruin-and-refill moves: high-pressure edges are deleted temporarily, their immediate re-addition is forbidden, and the newly opened space is refilled using balanced safe additions. Every completed candidate is explicitly verified using the common-neighbor characterization of C4-freeness.
